name: FIT_MAN
canonical: the fit man appointed to lead away the live goat, a wiry sinewy ancient Hebrew man of middle age, deeply sun-burnt leathery brown skin, a plain short black beard and close-cropped hair bound under a coarse head-cloth, dressed in a dust-ochre coarse tunic with a rope girdle, gripping the cord of the scapegoat in a calloused fist as he strides into the wilderness
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
